The Storm at the Edge of the Map

Welcome to Warpstorm — an unofficial Warhammer 40K beginner hub wrapped around an original dark sci-fi universe. Plain-English guides on choosing your first army, your first box and your first 500-point game. Plus the Workbench: miniature painting, weathering, kitbashing and 3D-printed terrain. Plus the Lore: an original universe of rusted ghost ships, void nomads and the rift that eats them.
